summary.result: Our results suggest that alleviating traffic congestion in addition to existing air pollution policies could improve air quality, even though such effects may not be substantial.
summary.background: Hence, we aim to examine the causal relationships between concentrations of particulate as well as ultrafine particulate matter and traffic congestion.
summary.method: The main findings from the panel models are as follows: First, traffic congestion is directly related to the concentrations of particulate and ultrafine particulate matter.
